objective: Implement the smallest deterministic cross-session Architect coordination creation-dedup fence identified by Trigger 7: add an explicit stable coordination intent identity (or equivalent deterministic semantic-boundary key) so concurrent Architect reentries cannot create multiple active packets for the same coordination objective, while preserving packet nonce/route identity for delivery idempotency and preserving all existing authority boundaries.
constraints: Refresh current F2 main and normal Trigger4 mutation authority before source mutation.
Use explicit deterministic intent identity; do not use embedding similarity or LLM semantic judgment as an authoritative dedup gate.
Keep intent creation dedup separate from packet delivery nonce/route idempotency.
Do not create a second project truth, state machine, runtime/effect authority, or release authority.
Use create-only/CAS or equivalent repository-safe ownership so two concurrent creators for one intent yield one active owner and one reuse/defer outcome.
Different wording with the same explicit intent identity must not produce parallel active coordination work.
Different intent identities must remain independently routable.
Expired or terminal intent may be superseded without rewriting immutable packet history.
Creation-dedup failure must never grant mutation, runtime, effect, product, or training credit.
Preserve and test compatibility with the deterministic ACK classifier fixed in commit 76c8943be674713f078df4de07badde5953f93f4.
